text:
Lina (sales): Heads-up: APAC POC starts tomorrow AM with a Singapore team. They explicitly pinned model = "redwood-large-v1" in their integration but calls from ap-sg are returning errors. Need quick triage + short dedicated trial pricing + security answers for their compliance check. Logs below.

Ethan (solutions-engineer): Paste the raw request and the error lines? Also did they pin by model name or model id/alias?

Lina (sales): They sent POST body with "model: "redwood-large-v1"". Proxy excerpt (redacted):
```
[2026-09-11T01:02:11Z] req=bd12a model=redwood-large-v1 region=ap-sg status=404 err=MODEL_NOT_FOUND msg="variant missing in region"
[2026-09-11T01:02:12Z] req=bd12b model=redwood-large-v1 region=ap-sg status=429 err=RATE_LIMIT msg="no fallback route"
```
They retried and saw more 429s. Customer asked: can we promise the exact model in APAC? If not, what quick alternatives and what's the cost for a 14-day dedicated trial (predictable throughput)?

Ravi (infra): Likely cause: exact artifact not staged in ap-sg. Fast remediation options:
- Enable account-level alias fallback so pinned name maps to local variant (e.g., redwood-large-v1-quant)
- Spin up a small Dedicated pool in ap-sg for the trial (reserve GPUs)
Need manifest id to push exact variant; otherwise alias approach is safer short-term.

Maya (security): Compliance questions flagged: KMS / envelope encryption, SOC2 certification evidence, and whether logs can be constrained to region. Hosted mode covers encryption at rest + SOC2 reports; for strict residency they require Dedicated or Private. If we do Dedicated trial we can set retention and log routing.

Ethan (solutions-engineer): Quick workaround for tomorrow: if they accept a compatible variant, we can flip a fallback rule that routes pinned="redwood-large-v1" -> "redwood-large-v1-quant" in ap-sg. Note: performance and cost may vary. We can also add a temporary header: `x-allow-fallback: 1` to force fallback behavior for testing. Example snippet:
```
POST /v1/chat.generate
Headers: {"Authorization": "Bearer <key>", "x-allow-fallback": "1"}
Body: {"model": "redwood-large-v1", "messages": [...] }
```

Infra-bot: Deployment lookup:
- redwood-large-v1: manifests -> M-1f4d (deployed: us-west, eu-west)
- redwood-large-v1-quant: manifests -> M-1f4d-q (deployed: ap-sg, eu-west)
- redwood-large-compat: manifests -> M-1f4d-c (deployed: ap-sg)
Replica counts (ap-sg): quant=3, compat=2

Ravi (infra): Confirmed. So the canonical artifact isn't in ap-sg. Short-term: alias fallback to quant or compat. Medium-term: manifest push to ap-sg (ETA ~24-48h if fast-track).

Lina (sales): Customer contact: jay.chen@corp-example.com. They prefer hosted but can accept Dedicated if needed for residency. Need a price ballpark for 2 x A100-equivalent reserved for 14 days and any expected lead time.

Billing-bot: Rough calc: infra cost ~ $9,000 - $13,000 (cloud infra) for 2 GPUs x14 days. Suggested customer package (includes 24/7 ops + monitoring + SLA for trial): $16k-$20k. Final quote depends on instance type and expected qps.

Maya (security): I'll assemble a short answers pack: KMS integration steps, SOC2 attestation link, and a template clause for regional log residency. I can send to Lina and copy Jay.

Ethan (solutions-engineer): Action items:
- Lina: confirm if customer accepts fallback to quant/compat (need explicit consent for quality/cost variance) - ASAP.
- Ravi/infra: standby to apply alias fallback to the customer's account routing (ETA ~90 mins once approved).
- Ravi/infra: if they require exact artifact, prepare manifest push ticket (longer).
- Maya: draft security responses and send to Jay.
- Billing: prepare a one-page trial quote for 2x A100-equiv / 14 days.

Lina (sales): I'll ask Jay about fallback acceptance now and report back. If they want the fallback we can unblock tomorrow; if they insist on exact model artifact in-region they'll need the Dedicated trial.

Ravi (infra): I'll queue the alias rule but won't flip until Lina confirms. If Lina says go, I'll enable and monitor for errors.

Lina (sales): Thanks team. Will update here in ~30m.

(30 minutes later)

Lina (sales): Jay confirmed: they're OK to try fallback to `redwood-large-v1-quant` for the POC. Wants note in writing that quantized variant may differ in latency/quality.

Ravi (infra): Enabling alias fallback now. Will monitor logs and post update.

Infra-bot: Alias rule applied for account acct-989: route pinned=redwood-large-v1 -> redwood-large-v1-quant in ap-sg.

Ravi (infra): Verified a few test requests succeeded; no 404s now. Still watching for 429s under load.

Ethan (solutions-engineer): Great. Lina please send Jay the security pack and the trial quote once Billing finalizes it. Keep a note that if they later require identical artifact we need a manifest push and ~1-2 day window.

Lina (sales): Will do. Closing the loop with Jay now. Thanks everyone.
